info.name: Speedrun API
info.description: Koleksi endpoint REST API untuk Proyek Speedrun (Users, User Settings, User Profiles, Genres, Games, Categories, Entries, Entry Verifications, Category Moderators, Game Administrators).

request.description:
Deskripsi: Buat profil user. Semua field opsional. updated_at otomatis.

Headers: Content-Type: application/json

Request Body:
{
  "bio": "Speedrunner baru",
  "avatar_url": "https://example.com/avatar.png",
  "twitch_url": "https://twitch.tv/newrunner",
  "youtube_url": "https://youtube.com/@newrunner",
  "social_media_url": "https://twitter.com/newrunner"
}

Response Sukses (201):
{
  "status": "success",
  "message": "Profil user berhasil dibuat",
  "data": {
    "user_id": 1,
    "bio": "Speedrunner baru",
    "avatar_url": "https://example.com/avatar.png",
    "twitch_url": "https://twitch.tv/newrunner",
    "youtube_url": "https://youtube.com/@newrunner",
    "social_media_url": "https://twitter.com/newrunner",
    "updated_at": "2024-08-01T10:00:00+00:00"
  }
}

Response Error (400):
{
  "status": "error",
  "message": "Field 'avatar_url' harus berupa URL valid (http/https)"
}

Response Error (409):
{
  "status": "error",
  "message": "User ID 1 sudah memiliki profil, gunakan PUT untuk memperbarui"
}

Deskripsi: Ambil semua game + filter genre & search.

Response Sukses (200):
{
  "status": "success",
  "total": 1,
  "data": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "name": "Super Mario 64",
      "genre_id": 1,
      "genre_name": "Platformer",
      "description": "Classic 3D platformer",
      "creator_id": 1,
      "latest_editor_id": 1,
      "created_at": "2024-01-05T10:00:00+00:00",
      "updated_at": "2024-06-20T11:30:00+00:00"
    }
  ]
}

Deskripsi: Buat game baru. created_at & updated_at otomatis.

Headers: Content-Type: application/json

Request Body:
{
  "name": "Celeste",
  "genre_id": 1,
  "description": "Indie platformer",
  "creator_id": 1
}

Response Sukses (201):
{
  "status": "success",
  "message": "Game berhasil ditambahkan",
  "data": {
    "id": 4,
    "name": "Celeste",
    "genre_id": 1,
    "genre_name": "Platformer",
    "description": "Indie platformer",
    "creator_id": 1,
    "latest_editor_id": 1,
    "created_at": "2024-08-01T10:00:00+00:00",
    "updated_at": "2024-08-01T10:00:00+00:00"
  }
}

Response Error (400):
{
  "status": "error",
  "message": "Genre dengan ID 999 tidak ditemukan"
}

Deskripsi: Update parsial game. updated_at otomatis berubah. creator_id tidak boleh diubah.

Deskripsi: Tambahkan entry baru. updated_at otomatis. video_url harus unik.

Headers: Content-Type: application/json

Request Body:
{
  "user_id": 1,
  "category_id": 1,
  "duration": 3600,
  "description": "Run bersih tanpa reset",
  "video_url": "https://youtu.be/xyz999"
}

Response Sukses (201):
{
  "status": "success",
  "message": "Entry berhasil ditambahkan",
  "data": {
    "id": 4,
    "user_id": 1,
    "category_id": 1,
    "category_name": "Any%",
    "duration": 3600,
    "description": "Run bersih tanpa reset",
    "video_url": "https://youtu.be/xyz999",
    "updated_at": "2024-08-01T10:00:00+00:00",
    "formatted_duration": "1h 0m 0s"
  }
}

Response Error (400):
{
  "status": "error",
  "message": "Field 'duration' harus lebih besar dari 0"
}

Response Error (409):
{
  "status": "error",
  "message": "video_url sudah digunakan oleh entry lain"
}
